subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: Should this PR be accepted with a proof override based on redacted pre-fix production logs plus positive/negative unit coverage, given the exact xAI provider-side rotation error cannot be induced on demand?
rationale: The code path and tests are strong, but the repository proof gate normally requires after-fix real behavior proof from an external PR, and the contributor has raised a credible feasibility constraint that needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Grant proof override
options.body: Accept the source-level reproduction, redacted production logs, and existing one-shot retry precedent as sufficient for maintainer review and possible merge.

options.title: Wait for organic proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until a future xAI rotation produces redacted after-fix gateway logs showing the retry succeeds.

options.title: Request alternate live proof
options.body: Ask for a maintainer-owned live harness or provider-assisted reproduction before merge, even though it may not exercise the exact code-less provider error.

recommendation.title: Grant proof override
recommendation.body: Accept the source-level reproduction, redacted production logs, and existing one-shot retry precedent as sufficient for maintainer review and possible merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the adjacent merged encrypted-reasoning retry behavior and is the strongest history-backed owner for deciding whether the same proof standard applies here.
